description: Run your social content workflow with Genviral. Review connected accounts, scheduled posts, analytics, and reusable content; research trends; organize files, folders, packs, templates, and slideshows; and create images, videos, and slideshows using your existing Genviral entitlements. You choose Personal or an accessible workspace during connection and approve separate read, write, publish, and media-generation permissions. Preparing a post never publishes it. Scheduling or publishing requires a separate explicit action, and generation can use credits already available in your Genviral account. A Genviral account is required, and publishing requires a supported social destination connected in Genviral.

defaultPrompt: List my connected social accounts and flag anything that needs attention.
Draft a LinkedIn post for Tuesday at 10:00 AM, but do not publish it.
Generate a slideshow draft for this brief, show the result, and do not publish it.
